title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns After Scandal Linking Him to Alleged Chinese Spy
summary: Nvidia's board announced on Nov 12 that Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member effective immediately, following scrutiny over personal affairs including an alleged relationship with a Chinese intelligence operative. CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO. The stock plummeted ~14%, wiping ~$546B in market value. Huang agreed to testify before Congress. Q3 FY2027 earnings report due Nov 17 is now the first post-Jensen test.
why: 英伟达是AI芯片核心持仓标的；CEO辞职+间谍丑闻+财报（11月17日）三重冲击压制整个AI板块期权隐含波动率，对套期策略影响重大。延续报道：事件自11月12日持续发酵，11月17日Q3财报为后续关键催化。

title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Tops 5.1%; Markets Await Fed Chair Warsh Speech as December Hike Odds Hit 92%
summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield surpassed 5.1% ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's speech at a conference today (Nov 16). CME FedWatch data cited in coverage shows markets pricing a 92% probability of a 25bp December rate hike to 4.00-4.25%, driven by hotter-than-expected October CPI. The 2-year yield posted its biggest weekly gain in over two years. Gold slid as investors repositioned ahead of Warsh's remarks.
why: 10年期美债突破5%对港美股整体估值形成压制；加息预期高企影响sell put策略行权价选择和组合成本；Warsh讲话鹰鸽倾向将直接影响12月会议前的波动率水平。CME FedWatch 92%概率数字来源：CNBC原文引用该工具数据。

title: Goldman Sachs Upgrades HK Stocks to Overweight, Cuts A-Shares to Neutral in 2027 Outlook; MSCI China +23% Target
summary: Goldman Sachs published its 2027 China equity outlook, upgrading Hong Kong H-shares to Overweight (from Neutral) and downgrading A-shares to Neutral. H-share valuations are near a cyclical low of 9.8x forward P/E; Goldman expects southbound inflows up to $100B in 2027. For A-shares, AI hard-tech profit momentum is forecast to slow from 85% to 46% growth. MSCI China index target is +23%; CSI 300 +10%. Semiconductors, healthcare, and consumer services upgraded to Buy.
why: 高盛港股升评是重要外资机构信号，可能拉动南向资金加速入场；对腾讯、阿里、美团等持仓构成正面支撑；A股降评提示AI硬科技盈利预期差风险，须关注A股仓位的估值压力。

title: 国家医保局发布2026年版基本医保及商保创新药两份目录，19家A股药企集中跟进披露
summary: 国家医保局等部门发布2026年版基本医保及商保创新药两份目录，19家A股上市药企同日跟进集中披露，新目录自2027年1月1日起执行。医药板块受利好催化，家电板块整体拉升。与此同时，创业板指盘中跌超2%，两市半日成交额约9006亿元。
why: 创新药医保目录是A股医药板块的阶段性催化事件；2027年1月生效时间节点明确，若持仓或关注医药类标的可留意期权机会；整体市场震荡提示需关注A股情绪对港股的传导。

title: Alibaba Unveils Qwen4-Max Flagship AI Model With 1M Token Context, Pairs With Custom Chip Push
summary: Alibaba opened preview access to Qwen4-Max, its largest flagship language model to date, featuring a 1 million-token context window and agent-first coding capabilities. The release reinforces Alibaba's 'model + compute' AI factory narrative alongside the concurrent T-Head chip unit Hong Kong IPO filing. Alibaba's stock was under pressure around HK$93-100 this week partly due to US remote AI chip access curbs concerns.
why: 延续报道：Qwen4-Max于11月11日开放预览，配合平头哥芯片子公司上市计划，是阿里AI竞争力里程碑叙事；对BABA/9988的期权隐含波动率有正面催化；阿里云业务是11月19日财报的核心观察指标。

title: SK Hynix HBM4 Yield Tops 70%; Expanding Capacity by 20,000+ Wafers/Month Targeting Mid-2027
summary: Industry reports indicate SK Hynix's HBM4 production yield has surpassed 70%, the highest in the industry, with the company in equipment procurement talks for further expansion at its Cheongju site targeting first half 2027. The company has reportedly locked over 50% of its 2027-28 HBM capacity with long-term agreements. Its HBM4 chip is slated for Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform.
why: 延续报道：HBM4产能动向是存储芯片供需格局关键信号，直接影响美光（MU）、SK海力士相关衍生品（CSOP南方两倍做多）的交易逻辑；英伟达CEO辞职引发的AI算力需求不确定性使该题材更敏感。

title: 小米集团（01810.HK）11月13日回购172.5万股，涉资约4983万港元
summary: 小米集团上周五（11月13日）回购172.5万股，每股回购价介乎28.82至29.02港元，合计涉资约4983.28万港元。小米近期股价约29港元，越南智能手机市场份额首次登顶，ASP提升55%部分抵消出货量下滑影响。
why: 小米持续回购显示管理层对当前估值的信心，对持有1810.HK或已卖出put的策略而言是短期支撑因子；关注小米汽车下一季度交付进展与指引。
